shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat upright slab
human-like or anthropomorphic figures with arms
horizontal registers/rows of repeated small motifs
justification: Both are upright rounded-topped slabs bearing shallow relief with figures arranged in registers, and both include arm-bearing anthropomorphic figures plus a band of small repeated signs across the upper zone. But the depicted content differs sharply: A shows a bestiary of quadrupeds, birds and a snake-like animal with a row of bucrania-like heads and no human costume, while B shows a group of clothed standing human figures facing one another in a gesture/offering scene beneath columns of script-like signs.
